title: Marketing Local: exemplos e estratégias usar | Eficaz Blog

facts.fact: The article states that the Portuguese keyword "como declarar imposto de renda" has 33,100 searches per month in Brazil.
facts.quote: a palavra-chave “como declarar imposto de renda” possuí 33.100 pesquisas por mês

facts.fact: According to the DataReportal report "Digital 2022: Brazil" as cited by the vendor, Brazil had more than 171 million social media users.
facts.quote: existem mais de 171 milhões de usuários de redes sociais no país

facts.fact: The vendor states that Brazil's more than 171 million social media users represent 79.9% of the population.
facts.quote: representa 79,9% da população, ou seja, é muito provável que seu público esteja nelas

facts.fact: The article defines Local Marketing as strategies focused on attracting customers who are close to the physical store.
facts.quote: Marketing Local são estratégias focadas em atrair clientes que estejam próximos da sua loja física.

facts.fact: The article presents 8 examples and strategies of Local Marketing: content marketing, SEO, paid media, geomarketing, email marketing, social media, offline campaigns, and online to offline.
The article was published on 21/10/2022 by the author admucom on the Eficaz blog.
